items:
Lakefront Paradise in the Emerald Coast’s Premier Golf & Beach Resort

Enjoy 10% Off 7-Night Stays—Book Direct with Code: 7nt10!
Special Offer: Unlock savings on your next vacation with our exclusive promotion: receive 10% off when you book a minimum 7-night stay directly on our website using coupon code 7nt10. This discount applies to new reservations only, so secure your dream getaway at a special rate. Other restrictions may apply—see booking details for full terms.

Property Overview: Lakeside Comfort Meets Coastal Luxury
Set within one of the Emerald Coast’s largest and most distinguished golf and beach resorts, this lakefront home offers the perfect blend of upscale amenities and natural beauty. Featuring three bedrooms and three bathrooms (two full and two half baths), the residence is designed for both relaxation and convenience.
The master king suite is situated on the first floor, providing easy access and privacy. Upstairs, the second and third bedrooms offer comfortable retreats for family or guests, while the loft area is equipped with a bunk bed and a cozy sitting space, ideal for children or extra visitors. Each room is thoughtfully decorated with elegant coastal accents and high-quality furnishings to ensure a restful stay.
Enjoy expansive lake views from the living room and porch, creating a tranquil backdrop for morning coffees, evening gatherings, or simply unwinding after a day of adventure. The home is centrally located within the resort, just steps away from the pool, hot tub, and clubhouse gym.

Amenities and Features
• FAST WiFi: Complimentary high-speed internet keeps you connected for work, play, and streaming.
• Golf Cart Access: Explore the resort with ease using the dedicated 4-person golf cart included with your rental. Need more room? Upgrade to a 6-person cart, or opt for both for larger groups (golf carts may differ from images).
• Fully Equipped Kitchen: The kitchen offers modern appliances, ample cookware, and dining ware, perfect for preparing meals.
• Washer & Dryer: Make packing easier—laundry facilities allow you to travel lighter and keep things fresh.
• Private Patio & Porches: Multiple outdoor spaces provide options for dining, relaxing, or taking in the lake’s scenic beauty.
• Smart TVs & Comfortable Furnishings: Each room features flat-screen TVs and plush seating for relaxed evenings indoors.
Resort and Local Attractions
• Laurel Grove Clubhouse: Just steps away, this clubhouse features a large heated pool during winter holidays, shaded arbors, an adjoining hot tub, gas BBQ grill and restrooms for convenience.
• Phil Hummel SOA Pool: Enjoy year-round access to a heated pool, perfect for swimming in any season.
• Private Beach: The resort’s white sand beach is complemented by beachside restaurants, often hosting local live bands for a festive atmosphere.
• Baytowne Wharf Village: Only 1.5 miles away, this vibrant area boasts shopping, dining, and nightlife, offering entertainment for guests of all ages.
• Grand Boulevard Mall: Conveniently located nearby, the mall features grocery stores, retailers, restaurants, and boutiques. A lighted tunnel beneath the highway lets you walk, bike, or rollerblade across the resort with safety and ease.
• Championship Golf Courses: Four professional courses provide variety for golf enthusiasts—book tee times and enjoy lush greens and scenic fairways.
• World-Class Tennis Courts: Challenge friends or family or take lessons at the resort’s premier facilities.
• Nature Trails: Miles of walking, running, biking, and rollerblading trails wind through the resort, ideal for morning jogs or sunset strolls.

Unique Benefits
• Free activities included in your stay! Your stay includes over $700 of FREE activities every day of your stay. With the Memories Fun Pass, all eligible reservations receive one free ticket, every day of your stay, to the following attractions:
• Sea Blaster Daytime and Sunset Dolphin Cruises
• Day Passes to Big Kahuna's Water Park
• Party Fishing Trips
• Golf at Regatta Bay
• Golf at Emerald Bay
• Golf at Windswept Dunes
• Golf Simulation Studio
• Baytowne Adventure Zone
• Indoor Black Light Mini Golf

• Heated Pools: Both the neighborhood pool (seasonally) and Phil Hummel SOA pool (year-round) are heated, ensuring swimming is comfortable regardless of the season.
• Golf Cart Convenience: The included golf cart allows you to easily access the beach, shops, restaurants, and entertainment at Grand Boulevard or Baytowne Wharf, eliminating the need to drive and park.
• Resort Atmosphere: The Emerald Coast’s largest resorts are renowned for their stunning beaches, emerald green waters, and inviting ambiance—a perfect escape to unwind and rejuvenate.
• Year-Round Sunshine: Western Florida enjoys over 300 sunny days annually, with water temperatures ranging from high 80s in summer to mid-60s in winter, making vacationing enjoyable any time of year.
• Global Recognition: Frommer’s named the Florida Panhandle among the top ten most beautiful places in the world for 2010, affirming the area’s breathtaking beaches and natural charm.

Pet Policy
Traveling with a furry friend? We consider small, preferably hypoallergenic, non-shedding dogs (with prior approval and pet fee) to make your trip even more enjoyable. Please inquire for details.

Ready for the Ultimate Lakefront Getaway?
Whether you’re traveling as a family, couple, or group, this lakefront home offers unparalleled comfort, stunning views, and endless recreation in the heart of the Emerald Coast’s top-rated resort. Enjoy the convenience of free activities, resort amenities, and easy access to the area’s most celebrated beaches and attractions. Book today, claim your exclusive discount, and set the stage for a truly unforgettable escape—where every detail is designed for relaxation and lasting memories.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
